scene mayapostcoitus1
: I’m sure Maya has...a perfectly reasonable explanation for not being here.
: Yeah, because you always give people the benefit of the doubt. I can’t do that, Ayane. I’ve been lied to too many times.
: That sort of thing wears a girl down, you know? And that’s why I think we need to be honest with one another.
: Let’s just...talk about something else for now.
: Better yet, let’s just sit in silence and play Mario Kart like real friends. No more talking until one of us has something funny to say.
: So...you’ll be keeping your mouth shut forever?
: Things not to say while your opponent is wielding a red shell.
: Holy shit...I needed that...
Today is Sunday, but I’m unsure of the current weather as a ghost showed up before I was able to step outside.
It’s a different ghost than normal, but another one dead set on preventing me from moving on by creating a world where I can’t even open my eyes without wanting to close them anymore.
No matter how many times I try to block her out, she just keeps coming. And while I admire that sort of uncharacteristically headstrong tenacity, I can’t help but wish she was a little more absent.

I can’t help but wish her tenacity only existed behind the scenes in a manner that would cause her to silently suffer while I reap the benefits of something that could only be called “divine punishment.”
I’m sure that’s a little selfish of me- but I’m a selfish person. And I’m sure it’s what she would want as well since it’s that exact thing that kept us together for as long as we were.
Now here I lie with a corpse that bears her scent — that horrid hint of watermelon and the gaping hole it drills into my throat as it pours in through my sinuses.

I try to block that out too, but every once in a while I’ll accidentally feel her hair on my skin. Or her fingertips. Or her mouth — and each one gnaws away at every fiber of my being and reminds me of what I’ve lost.
I know now the pain she must have felt. I can feel a trace of it each and every time I submit to her. And I will keep submitting to her because how can I not?
If it looks like her and smells like her and speaks like her and loves like her, can I be forgiven for pretending it is her?
Or would I be better off trying to let go of one more piece of me when I know it’s the only one I have left?
: You don’t know what time it is, do you?
: No, but I know you should probably leave before Ami’s sixth sense kicks in and we both wind up dead.
: I doubt she’ll actually come here. We were planning on meeting at Ayane’s place and that’s a decent way away. I’ll just have to answer a phone call or two.
scene mayapostcoitus2
: Then you can screw me one more time before I leave. But I’m taking the bottom this time since I need a break from riding you.
: Just save it for next time. I can’t do any more today.
scene mayapostcoitus3
: Sure you can. I know your limits. I’ve tested them probably ten thousand times.
: I’m just not feeling well, okay?
scene mayapostcoitus4
: Is this post-sex depression again? Or like, actual depression? Because it’s hard to tell with you sometimes.
: Who even knows at this point?
scene mayapostcoitus5

: Well, whatever it is, can you knock it off? And I mean that in the most sincere way possible. I’ve just barely seen you at all lately and I don’t want what little time we do have to be all sad and...quiet.
: Funny. It feels like not so long ago you were practically begging me to keep my mouth shut.
: Uhh...when? I don’t remember that at all.
: Yeah, you wouldn’t.
scene mayapostcoitus6
: Ahh, okay. You must be talking about Maya the time-traveler again. The one you fell in love with who then went back to the future to be all hot and cool over there.

: You know, that’s essentially cheating. Even if it is just a clone of me from another timeline or something. I can’t help but be a little offended, but honestly? I get it. I’d probably bang future Akira too.
scene mayapostcoitus7
: Or past Akira. I’ve never gotten to fuck someone my own age before. Maybe I’d like it better?
: What if that Maya’s...inside of you somewhere?
: Did you not hear me? I literally just said I’ve never gotten to fuck someone my own age before.
scene mayapostcoitus8
: I mean her memories. The ones I made with her over the last several years. All those times on the rooftop...those late night errands and...weird boxes she made me carry.
: Do you really not remember any of that?
: Boxes?
: One’s she’d keep in her dorm...that she’d need to carry over to school in the middle of the-
scene mayapostcoitus9
: Ah!
: Do you...actually remember?
: I remember...
scene mayapostcoitus10
: I remember I brought breakfast!
scene black
: Aaah~ I was so excited to have sex that I totally forgot how kind and generous I am as a significant other.
scene mayapostcoitus11
: Also, you wouldn’t happen to have any morning-after pills in here, would you? Or I guess...morning-of? Baby busters? Anti-Sensei semen pills?
Of course she didn’t actually remember...
What Noriko said about Maya’s memories potentially being trapped inside like mine would be way too convenient to actually be true.

Things that good don’t happen to me. Not without some monkey’s paw getting in the way at least. But at least a hand like that would be easier to hold and less prone to snapping when I squeeze too hard.
: I don’t have anything.
scene mayapostcoitus12
: We should really start keeping those on-hand.
: I don’t think they’re really meant to be a staple contraceptive.
scene mayapostcoitus13
: Really? I wouldn’t know. My teacher never taught me about safe sex.
: I’m talking about you. You’re the teacher who never taught me about safe sex.
: Yeah. I got that, Maya.
: Because you were too busy fucking me.
: Yes. I get it. Thanks.
scene mayapostcoitus14
: So irresponsible, Sensei. If you’re going to have sex with a student, you should at least teach them how to do it without potentially ruining their life and vagina.
scene mayapostcoitus15
: I’ll keep that in mind the next time you make the terrible decision of coming over here first thing in the morning.
: Sounds good. Does tomorrow work for you? I’ve got some spare time for a creampie or two before math. Where did I throw my bra? I thought- oh. Found it.
: You’d show up even if I said no.
scene mayapostcoitus16
: That’s right. Because unlike somebody, I’m actually a good person.
: Well...mostly good. Good to you.
scene mayapostcoitus17

: Which I guess technically means I’m a bad person since I’m...not taking anyone else’s feelings into account? I’m not really sure. But that’s not my fault because my teacher never taught me morals or ethics either.
scene mayapostcoitus16
: Anyway, the point of the story is that instead of running away from me ever again, you should just pull me aside and take your feelings out on me physically. I can take it. I want to take it.
: Yeah, you made that very apparent during the last Dorm Wars.
scene mayapostcoitus18
: Oh, I made it apparent long before that. But I forgive you for temporarily forgetting our past when I just rode you so hard that you’re probably still seeing the Pleiades. Get up. I’m hungry.
: I’m not-
: I said get up. You need to eat something.
scene black
: Ugh...fine.
scene mayapostcoitus19
She doesn’t even bother getting fully dressed before marching over to the kitchen and going through the cabinets.
The way she moves alone is more than enough to make me believe she’s done this time and time before. But is this...really the way it was?
Were we so accustomed to sneaking around that she developed the confidence needed to parade around my home with my cum still clinging to her thighs?
This isn’t comfort — this is recklessness. This is the type of thing that I should be doing, not her.
She is stoic. Unmoving. Temperamental, but smart. She’s a creature of logic and habit but habits like these are...
I barely recognize her...
But still it...feels so familiar.
It’s so comforting that all I can think of doing is crawling back into bed. But even that thought is pushed back by the idea that she’d just crawl into it with me.
So despite being here in the life I’ve always wished for...all I wish is for its end. For her to close that fucking cabinet.
: You’re running low on hot sauce.
: I’ll be sure to let Ami know.
: Black pepper too.
: If I knew you’d be taking inventory today, I’d have gone to the store first.
: You didn’t even know I was coming over today. You were probably too busy dreaming about me.
: You have no idea how right you are.
scene mayapostcoitus20
: Probably because I’m always right.
: And so humble as well.
scene mayapostcoitus19
: You’re lucky you get to dream about me. All my dreams have been fucking weird lately.
: Not even the sexy kind of weird either. Just weird in general. Like last night? I was just flying. That was it. That was the whole dream.
: That’s not even remotely weird when compared to what I’ve been dreaming lately.
: It was weird because it wasn’t weird, you know? Like, dreams are supposed to be illogical and random, aren’t they? What does it say about my mind if mine are so boring and anticlimactic?
: That you’re content and...comfortable with the way things are?

: Maybe. I guess that’s not entirely wrong now that you’re not in a fucking coma anymore. But it’d still be cool if you could come back to school so I don’t have to come all the way over here to see you.
scene mayapostcoitus20
: I guess there’s your other place now too, though. But Chika saw me leaving after we had make-up sex the other day and now I’m going to have to figure out her schedule, so thanks for that.
: She saw you? She didn’t say anything, did she?
scene mayapostcoitus19
: She said a few things. But I’m not sure how to talk about them without getting mad and I don’t think we have enough time for more sex without skipping breakfast- which I am not going to do.
: Maya-
: Save it. Don’t want to know. Better off that way. Also, I am way prettier than her and you’re in love with me. I have never felt less threatened in my life.
: You’re low on onion salt too.
scene mayapostcoitus21
: I’ll be sure to let Ami know about that as well...
: Is that my phone or yours? Just let it go to voicemail if-
scene mayapostcoitus22
: Hello?
: Or fuck me, I guess. But in the less cool way.
scene mayapostcoitus23
: Well, I guess that background voice answers my first question.
: I didn’t know she was coming.

: It’s fine, Sensei. Do you know if she’s at least planning on meeting up with us, though? Because Ami’s being kind of weird again and I could use a buffer that isn’t going to invite me to any threesomes.
if ayanecthree == True:
: Chika’s there too?
: Nope. Different threesome this time. I’m a popular girl.
: Did Ami really-
: Yeah, but we can talk about that later. It’s not really a thing I want to bring up when she’ll be back from the buffet any second now.
: Your house has a buffet?
scene mayapostcoitus24
: Not normally. But Geoffrey threw one together today since it’s the first time in a while I’ve had anyone over.
: I’ll make sure Maya heads over soon. I don’t really want her here either.
: Wooooooooooow. Just hit it and quit it then. I see how it is.
scene mayapostcoitus25
: Hey, uhh...
: Do you want to come over too, Sensei?
: Uhh...I don’t really know if-
: Not today. Like...maybe Friday night, though?
: I’ve been kind of...busy lately. With apocalypse stuff.
: I know that’s probably the last thing on your mind right now given everything thats happened and whatnot, but...
: With you being mostly out of commission, Maya being completely out of commission, and Makoto just not really giving a shit...I’d feel weird if I just let things go on like “normal,” you know?
: Somebody’s gotta do something. And, while they probably all suck, I did come up with a few ideas I’d like to run by you if that’s okay.
: Just you and me?
: And Makoto if I can get her here. But, again, she doesn’t really seem to care.
: Friday?
scene mayapostcoitus26
: Only if you can make it. I don’t want to force anything on you if you’re still...getting over things.
: I’ll be there. I’m sorry I haven’t been around, Ayane.
: There’s nothing to apologize for, Sensei.
scene mayapostcoitus27
: Oh, wait. I’m supposed to call you “Dad” now.
: Uhh...you’re supposed to do what?
scene mayapostcoitus28
: Nothing! Talk to you later, Dad! Love you, Dad! Bye, Dad!
: Uhh...
: Was that Ayane calling you “Dad” just now?
: I...guess so?
: Ew. Make her stop. I don’t like that.
scene black
: Make her stop yourself when you get over there.
: Can I at least eat first? Also, can you pay for my taxi? I spent the last of my money buying you this breakfast that you’re not going to eat.
: Yeah...I’ll pay for your taxi.
I agree only because I want her out of here as soon as possible.
This house is haunted — and I can’t stand being alone inside of it anymore.
